meta.name: gpt-image-skill
meta.description: Generate or edit images using OpenAI GPT Image API (gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1, etc). Use ONLY when the user explicitly names OpenAI or GPT as the provider: "gpt image", "openai image", "generate image with openai", "用 openai 画图", "用 GPT 生成图片". For generic image requests without a provider, use nanobanana-skill instead. Do NOT use for diagrams (架构图/流程图) — draw those with Mermaid or code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenAI 生成或编辑图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用 OpenAI 的 GPT 模型生成或编辑图片
copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit images using OpenAI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or edit images with OpenAI's GPT models

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能用 OpenAI 的 GPT 图像模型生成或编辑图片。它会询问你想要的画面、尺寸等，然后调用脚本创建图片，并告诉你保存位置。
howto.when: 当你明确提到“OpenAI”或“GPT”来生成或编辑图片时触发，例如说“用 GPT 画图”或“用 OpenAI 生成图片”。

say.text: 用 GPT 帮我画一张日落时的山景。
say.note: Claude 会询问细节并生成图片。

say.text: 用 OpenAI 编辑这张照片，在天空加一道彩虹。
say.note: 需要提供图片文件，Claude 会进行编辑。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate or edit images using OpenAI's GPT Image models. It will ask for your description, size, etc., then run a script to create the image and show you the saved file path.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly mention "OpenAI" or "GPT" for image generation or editing, e.g., "generate image with openai" or "用 GPT 画图".

say_en.text: Use GPT to draw a sunset mountain landscape.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details and generate the image.

say_en.text: Edit this photo with OpenAI, add a rainbow in the sky.
say_en.note: You need to provide the image file; Claude will edit it.
